$comment: Recorded transfer sizes for the published package. Regenerate with `bun --filter sherick-ui test:bundle --update`; both a deliberate increase and a stale decrease need a reason in the pull request.

button.definition: Button alone through the root export. Guards against the root barrel pulling optional feature code.

form.definition: Representative form composition: Button, Checkbox, Combobox, Field, Input, NumberField, RadioGroup, Select, Slider, Switch.

overlay.definition: Representative overlay composition: AlertDialog, Combobox, Dialog, Drawer, Menu, Popover, Select, Tooltip.

disclosure.definition: The disclosure family: Accordion and Collapsible, which share one row and one measured panel.

toast.definition: The toast stack: its provider, its viewport and the two ways a toast is raised.

toggles.definition: Representative toggle composition: Chip, ChipGroup, Progress, SegmentedControl, ToggleGroup.

barrel.definition: The complete core root barrel with nothing tree-shaken beyond unused exports.

content.definition: The optional rich-content subpath: Markdown, CodeBlock and their full dependency stack.
